messages.subject: Cristina | Confidential Executive Profile | Energy, Industrial, ESG & Corporate Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Postolache,

Your Amrop work across Energy & Infrastructure, Industrial, Life Sciences and senior leadership search makes you a relevant contact for my next international move.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive advisory for a major international mining operation undergoing substantial capital investment and renewable-energy expansion.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, VP-track and country-facing mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Energy & Infrastructure and General Management.

I am internationally mobile and open to Romania, Central and Eastern Europe and wider expatriate assignments. I have attached a tailored executive-search CV and would welcome confidential consideration for relevant mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
